reason: I'd take the free six-week test because it costs me nothing but an export and a few forwarded emails. I would not sign up for $2,000 a month from a company that may not be around next year, and I'd have to explain that payback to our CFO with nothing but a pilot result.
objection: A pre-MVP startup might not be around next year. If it folds after I've wired it into our buyers' routine, I've lost the time and I'm back to chasing shortages by hand.
would_change_my_mind: A plant that ran the free test shows me a real late or short order that the tool caught in time, with the dollar value written down, and the vendor commits to continuity terms I can show the CFO.
